description: Parking Points is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Parks and Recreation. Parking: A simplified point layer of the centroids of California State Parks parking area polygons, providing location, name, type and other attributes. Current as of February 2026. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Parks and Recreation. Its tags are Activities, CAOpenData, California Department of Parks and Recreation, California Natural Resources Agency, California State Parks. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
